at.description: Wall time when this cycle control part ended; frozen before snapshot publication, not the final object put time.

ok.description: The control part completed with its confirmed inputs/writes and no control-step failure; snapshot outcomes are recorded separately.

error.description: the text of the last error or an empty string

failures.description: Independent control-step failures of this cycle; snapshot publication outcomes do not increment this field.

last_success.description: Last successful control-part completion time, unchanged by a later snapshot publication failure.

seconds.description: Duration of this cycle control part only, excluding snapshot and final-report publications.

manifest_rev.description: the manifest revision of the controller

manifest_behind.description: rows of this pass whose write was postponed because of a lagging manifest; a row — once per pass

names_given.description: names given away by the fate; the worker reads them at capture (P/03.2 N3 «capture»)

additionalProperties.description: the version of the slot row (index P/01.1 N1, an opaque string) at which the name was given away (N3 «fate» names_given)

hung_move_after.description: seconds of the hang limit in force at this controller (N1.4 HUNG_MOVE_AFTER); the worker reads it

fates.description: only taken slots not given away (holder non-empty, released false)

rev.description: the version of the judgment about the slot

since.description: the moment the slot entered this fate by the controller's clock

snapshot_tables_refused.description: Tables replaced by the too_large stub during this cycle at SNAPSHOT_TABLE_MAX; included in this same final report, outside control-step failures.

snapshot_rows_garbled.description: Unreadable snapshot fields omitted by unit/table publications of this same cycle; reset only for the next cycle after this final report.

additionalProperties.description: a non-empty reason — why of /unplaceable and reason of 404 `/where/<id>`

units.description: Exact nonnegative sum of waiting unit weights, in integer JSON notation, without an upper common.uint53 bound. Preserve the whole serialized-report limit; never round or saturate through binary64/int64 (P/04-R007).

workers.description: processes needed beyond the live ones and the capacity in flight

withheld.description: words for why it was not ordered

additionalProperties.description: An own counter of the short element; standard properties keep their declared forms.

live.description: live processes of the role of the server

since.description: the moment the order was removed

near_waiting.description: the subsystems of placement.near.sub that are not in the manifest catalog of this pass: the affinity waits for their installation (N1.3 near); otherwise there is no field

expired_kept.description: Manual rows retained after ends removed them; required nonnegative count for current reader and writer, zero when none.

snapshot_state_garbled.description: Unreadable unit states omitted by the unit snapshot publications of this same cycle; reset only for the next cycle after this final report.

state_swept_total.description: Cumulative confirmed orphan-state deletions from this process start; not reset between cycles.

additionalProperties.description: the implementation's own counters (N1.2 — MAY add)

common.book_missing.description: who is missing in the book — [{member, why}] class server first, within by member in UTF-8 bytes, one per book (P/08.5 N1.3 missing); the order and «one per member» — a rule of the lesson, not the form

member.description: the member because of which something is missing in the book

why.description: a closed list of words (P/08.5 N1.3 why); a member has one entry

common.book_row.description: a row of the assembled book (P/08.5 N1.3 result): the element "" — the JSON text {missing, missing_count}, the element `<key>` — the JSON text {entries} only with elements where the recipient is in to; at the holder the secrets of value — envelopes of the holder's ring enc:v2 (N1.3 at_rest), at the member — envelopes of the member's ring (P/09.1 N1.4 member_row); the keys of the elements — arbitrary

properties.description: the JSON text {missing, missing_count} — the completeness of the book without keys

missing.description: the first MISSING_SHOWN 500: class server first, within by member (P/08.5 N1.3 result)

missing_count.description: all members in missing (P/08.5 N1.3 result)

term.description: a book to: "*": the term of the write of the row

rev.description: a book to: "*": the version of the row

stale.description: a book to: "*" with stale: <member>/<server> — the worker of the book's subsystem is silent, the first MISSING_SHOWN 500 by UTF-8 bytes (P/08.5 N1.3 head)

anyOf.description: key of the book — the value of the field key of the entry, a non-empty string (P/03.7 N1.2 entry)

entries.description: the elements of the key for this recipient by (member, item) in UTF-8 bytes (N1.3 order — a rule of the lesson, not the form)

member.description: the contributor member — from the origin of the report, not from the input

item.description: `<slot>/<item>` for a family, `<item>` for a single row

value.description: the input object as is; the secrets *_secret — ring envelopes (enc:v2), AAD — the row key 0x00 «/<row item>» + the JSON Pointer of the secret (N1.3 at_rest)

common.domain_backup_doc.description: the backup document (P/08.8 N1.5 document) — JCS {term, rev, holder, at, members, state, objects, raw?, backup_key_rev, holder_member_key?, issuer, kid, sig}, a closed set; one document at the holder (the object `domain/backups/rev-<rev>`) and at the keeper (the object domain/backup); the signature — by the issuer, the check — the function record of the term record contract (the kind «backup document»; the types — step 1, not_a_record). The document carries no domain: the issuer binds it to the domain (record steps 3–5)

rev.description: the backup revision; grows only when the content changes (N1.5 rev)

holder.description: the name of the holder member (P/08.1 N1.1 member)

at.description: wall-clock seconds of the signature; a JSON number (record step 1: at — a number)

members.description: the names of the member list, without repeats

state.description: {<row key>: {<element>: <text>}} — the rows that the domain decided and that nobody else has (N1.5 state)

propertyNames.description: the key of a state row (N1.5 state)

additionalProperties.description: the value of the element as stored (text); *_secret — an enc:v2 envelope of the backup key (N1.5 secrets)

objects.description: `{<object key>: <JSON>}` — the shared document and the alarm history (N1.5 objects); only objects in the form of their family, as a value

raw.description: `{<object key>: <base64>}` — the objects of the copy not in the form of their family — not JSON or JSON not by the form, as bytes (N1.5 raw)

propertyNames.description: the object key; a key — in objects or in raw, not in both (N1.5 raw; in both — record step 1, not_a_record)

additionalProperties.description: base64 of the object's bytes, RFC 4648 §4, with padding; an object of 0 bytes — an empty string

backup_key_rev.description: the revision of the backup key (N1.5 backup_key)

holder_member_key.description: hex of the public key of the holder member, 32 bytes; the key of the former one in the list after a move (N1.2 former)

issuer.description: hex of the issuer's public key, 32 bytes (the term record contract)

kid.description: serial of the issuer — the first 16 characters of hex issuer; anything else — function record steps 3–5, not the form

sig.description: base64url without = of the issuer's Ed25519 signature over UTF-8(JCS(doc without kid and sig)), 64 bytes; not base64url, not 64 bytes or does not match — function record step 5 (bad_signature), not the form

common.domain_backup_pointer.description: the pair of the backup and its sum {term, rev, sha256} (P/08.8 N1.5 keepers): the holder's pointer domain/keepers/<member> and the keeper's row domain/backup-taken

term.description: the term of the holder that issued the backup

sha256.description: hex sha256 of the JCS text of the backup document

common.domain_member.description: the member's name — CLUSTER of its installation, 1–64 characters [a-z0-9-] (P/08.1 N1.1 member)

common.domain_member_entry.description: the member entry Entry (P/08.3 N1.1); by — only at admitted, Entry not larger than ENTRY_MAX 1240 bytes of JCS (P/08.10 N1.5) — checks of the lesson at the writer, not of the form

how.description: where the member in the list comes from — "admitted" | "holder" | `"held the domain until term <N>"` (P/08.3 N1.1; the last two — P/08.8 N1.2)

since.description: the holder's wall-clock seconds of the record

by.description: the person who admitted the member (P/08.4; before it — operator); only at admitted

key.description: the key of the member admitted by the fingerprint; at holder — the key from the first report of its agent

revoked_keys.description: the former keys of this name, revoked; not more than the 4 latest (P/08.10 N1.5)

ca.description: the member's CA fingerprints (sha256 DER), 1–2, ascending, without repeats (P/08.3 N1.6 Entry.ca)

class.description: server — a cluster with servers, camera — a camera cluster (P/08.3 N1.1)

url.description: the entry address, not longer than 256 bytes (P/08.1 N1.4)

common.domain_member_key.description: hex of the member's Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes (the member key P/09.1 N1.1 pub; Entry.key P/08.3 N1.1)

common.domain_members_doc.description: doc of the holder's row domain/member-rows/<part> (P/08.3 N1.1) and of its copy domain/member-list/<part> at the member — JCS text (P/09.1 N1.1, N1.4)

term.description: the term of the holder that wrote the row (P/08.8 N1.1; installation — 1)

members.description: the entries of the members of this part, the holder is in the count of its own part (P/08.10 N1.5)

issuer.description: hex of the issuer's public key

kid.description: the first 16 characters of hex issuer

sig.description: the issuer's signature over UTF-8(JCS(doc without kid and sig))

gathered.description: a row of the gathering «from nothing»: the source of the part at the write, null — there is no source (P/08.8 N1.8a gathered)

new.description: the names new of the part, the members of this row (P/08.8 N1.8a gathered)

common.domain_outcome.description: the outcome of the edit — the JSON text of the element `<id>` of the outcomes row: at the holder domain/outcomes/<member> (P/08.6 N1.6), at the member domain/outcomes (P/09.1 N1.5 outcome)

id.description: id of the edit (P/08.6 N1.4 id); equal to the element's name — a rule of the lesson (settle, P/08.6 N1.6)

status.description: the response code of the member's console

error.description: detail of the response (no detail — its error) at status ≥ 400, without the values of secrets

kept_at.description: at of the edit (P/08.6 N1.4 at)

made.description: id of the created unit: POST of the unit, the link with new or create (P/09.1 N1.5 made)

by.description: the person of the edit: by of the edit; none — the viewer of the domain (P/08.6 N1.6)

common.domain_placement.description: the placement record — the holder's row `domain/placement/<sub>/<ref>` (P/08.6 N1.1) and its copy at the member `domain/placed/<sub>/<ref>` («the elements of the record as at the holder», P/09.1 N1.5 member)

cluster.description: the executor member; required; "" — not by the form (the form of the door — 400, P/08.6 N1.1 form)

origin.description: the member owning the source; "" — none; origin — not an executor (P/08.6 N1.1 executors)

copies.description: the JCS text of an array of other executors, ascending, without repeats, without cluster; "[]" — none (the order and «without cluster» — rules of the lesson, not of the form)

at.description: wall-clock seconds of the domain process of the write

rev.description: the value of the counter domain/placement of this record, as decimal text (P/08.6 N1.1 rev)

common.domain_topology_doc.description: doc of the holder's row domain/topology (P/08.3 N1.2) and of its copy domain/member-topology at the member — JCS text (P/09.1 N1.4)

centre.description: a member — the centre of the domain; none — there is no centre

via.description: member → the relay through which it reports; no member — directly

by.description: who wrote — the name proven by the gate

relays.description: who leads at least one member (P/08.3 N1.2)

common.grants_doc.description: the JCS text {lines} of the grants row (P/08.4 N1.3); the member's copy carries it as it came (P/09.1 N1.4 member_copy)

lines.description: lines by (subject, cap, sub, scope) in UTF-8 bytes, then until by number, without repeats by (subject, cap, sub, scope, until) — the order and the repeat — a rule of the row (P/08.4 N1.3 lines), not the form

subject.description: a person's name (N1.1), a subject of the name index (chapter 8.5 N1.7) or role:<role name> (N1.3a, up to 69 characters); the form of the name — N1.1 (N3 «grants» step 3)

cap.description: none < view < edit < admin; none — only at a role row: a rule of the row, not the form

sub.description: the manifest name (P/02.1 N1.2 name) or platform; no field — the row is in force in all subsystems and in platform

scope.description: `*` | `unit:<sub>/<id>` | `labels:<label>[,<label>…]` \| `folder:<id>` (P/08.4 N1.3 scope): `<sub>` — the manifest name (P/02.1), `<id>` — by the identifier grammar P/06.1 N1.3 (named_id: not . and ..), labels — the label alphabet common/contracts/labels.md; labels without repeats — a rule of the row, not the form; `folder:<id>` — the folder id, 32 lowercase hex digits (P/06.8 N1.1)

until.description: 0 — without a deadline; otherwise wall-clock seconds — the line is in force while now < until; an input with more than three fraction digits — rounding to thousandths (P/08.4 N1.3 until); compared by value (0 and 0.0 — one line)

by.description: the name proven by the gate at the write; a line matching by (subject, cap, scope, until) keeps its by

common.named_id.description: unit id by a field (P/06.1 N1.3 named): non-empty; without / \ | " comma, control characters (Cc), line and paragraph separators (Zl, Zp) and digits outside 0–9 (non-ASCII Nd); the categories — Unicode 15.0.0

common.person_name.description: the person's name (P/08.4 N1.1 name): 1–64 characters without whitespace, control characters (U+0000–U+001F, U+007F) and : | ( ) " /; not exactly break-glass; whitespace — the White_Space property of Unicode 15.0.0, written out as characters; «not a subject of the name index» — a check of the door (chapter 8.5 N1.7), not the form

common.shared_doc.description: the shared document of the domain (P/08.9 N1.2 document) — JCS {domain, term, rev, at, by, shared, issuer, kid, sig}, a closed set; one document at the holder (the object `domain/shared-docs/rev-<rev>`) and at the member (the object domain/shared — a copy taken by the agent, P/09.1 N1.10); the signature — by the issuer, the check — the function record of the term record contract (the kind «shared document»)

domain.description: the domain name (chapter 8.2); another JSON type or ≠ the domain of the set — function record step 2 (another_domain), not the form

term.description: the holder's term (chapter 8.8); the order — (term, rev), term is senior

by.description: the name proven by the gate; after a move — "domain"

shared.description: `{<sub>: {<name>: <value>}}` — only what is declared P/02.1 N1.2b; subsystems and names ascending (JCS)

additionalProperties.description: the values of the subsystem `<sub>` — the names of its domain.shared
the value of a field or a document declared by domain.shared of the manifest

issuer.description: hex of the issuer's public key (the term record contract, issuing_key_secret)

kid.description: serial of the issuer — the first 16 characters of hex issuer; anything else — function record steps 3–5, not the form

sig.description: base64url without «=» of the issuer's Ed25519 signature over UTF-8(JCS(doc without kid and sig)), 64 bytes; anything else — function record step 5 (bad_signature), not the form

common.time.description: time N0 P/01.1 «Time in a row»

labels.description: the label set — the canonical notation in ascending order (N3 «set order»)

server_name.description: the server name — the grammar of SERVER_NAME (P/02.4 N1.2)
